notes.title: Zombie Mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rGQ4xpGPlEw;full][/previewyoutube]Hello everyone, finally the long-awaited zombie mode update. We have been working on it for a long time and went to release it and now we are ready to show it to you.
[b]Basic mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Infinite number of waves. With each wave the zombies get bigger and stronger.
[*] Variety of weapons
[*] For every zombie you kill, you receive points, as well as points for hitting the body, which you can spend on buying new weapons and ammo.
[*] Cooperative multiplayer for up to 4 people (the more people, the more difficulty increases)
[/list]

Another big news, we have moved the shooter mode in beta branch, and zombie mode made a basic, so if you want to play in the shooter it will be found in the beta version in the settings steam. This is done in order to completely rewrite and clean up, we hope you will take this information with understanding.

[b]The following is what I would like to say about our future mode updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding new weapon models
[*] Improvements and new animations to be added
[*] Add new maps
[*] Add zombie boss that will appear after certain waves
[*] New characters with unique abilities 
[*] New bonuses to be dropped from zombies
[*] New melee weapons and grenades to be added  
[/list]
That's not all, that's the main thing that will be used now.

We hope that you will enjoy the mode very much.
Also, if anyone will find bugs write in the discussion in the "Game Feedback" this will greatly reduce the time of finding bugs in the game

notes.title: New Map Forest
notes.content:
We very much hoped to add a new mode with zombies to Halloween, but it so happened that we will not release a completely raw mode and decided to make the new beautiful forest map. Very large map where you need to walk a lot, run and be very careful because the enemy and you including very bad visibility, but if you take a good position to attack or defend, you can get a very good advantage over the enemy.

And now in brief:
[list]
[*] Added a box with ammo on all maps where you can refill weapons with ammo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38828296/99d312f8085ac0c740ddec87a7d275c6f41cf3f4.jpg[/img]
[*] The bugs you wrote to us, let's be honest, we haven't fixed them, they will be fixed with the new mode as it is related to the animation work.
[/list]
Forest map was added only in one mode "Conquest" and we thought to ask you if you should add it in other modes, if you have something to say or you want to see this map in other modes write we will be glad to first of all feedback secondly your opinion

P.S.
We will try to show screenshots or make a video clip of the new zombie mode in the near future. We liked the mode very much and we think that you will like it too.
And now there are not many screenshots.
